gear.name: Crampons
gear.description: Steel-spiked boots: climb ice without slipping.

gear.name: Thermal Suit
gear.description: High-altitude cold drains your warmth 4 times slower.

gear.name: Grappling Hook
gear.description: Click a distant wall: the rope pulls you up. Gets you past smooth walls.

gear.name: Reinforced Pickaxe
gear.description: Gold and crystal tip: mines Ruby and Cosmic ore.

gear.name: Paraglider
gear.description: Press Space while falling to open it and glide down the mountain.

gear.name: Dragon Saddle
gear.description: Ride your adult dragon: press H (or Ride) and fly anywhere.

gear.name: Pitons (+4)
gear.description: Forge four wall pitons from the iron in your pack.

gear.name: Torch
gear.description: Lights up caves and the night, and warms your hands a little.

gear.name: Bandages
gear.description: Patch yourself up after a fall: +40 health.

shop.name: Pitons (refill)
shop.description: Refills your stock of rock pitons.

shop.name: Mystery Egg
shop.description: Random element. 75% Common, 22% Rare, 3% Epic. Goes into your nest.

shop.name: Rare Egg
shop.description: Random element. 85% Rare, 13% Epic, 2% Legendary. Goes into your nest.

upgrades.name: Grapple Strike
upgrades.description: Grapple an enemy: you fly at it, hit it and stun it. Upgrades make it hit harder.

upgrades.name: Axe Throw
upgrades.description: Thrown Ice Axe (Q): more damage, more range, bounces to other enemies.

upgrades.name: Exoskeleton
upgrades.description: Frame on your back: stamina lasts longer and falls hurt less.

upgrades.name: Frost Shield
upgrades.description: Ice shield that soaks up hits and recharges when you're safe.

upgrades.name: Swift Boots
upgrades.description: Lighter boots: you walk and run faster.

upgrades.name: Plunge Attack
upgrades.description: Land on enemies from high up: shockwave damage and no fall damage.
